body:
twenty years ago tomorrow. that's how long we've had this album 🤍

she was 16. she wrote over 40 songs for it, kept eleven, and put her name on every single writing credit — three of them ("the outside," "should've said no," "our song") written completely alone.

and then it just… refused to leave. it entered the billboard 200 at no. 19 and stayed 157 weeks — the longest chart run of any album of the 2000s.

even the liner notes were hiding things: read only the capital letters in each printed lyric and they spell out a little secret message per song. the easter eggs started right here, in 2006.

twenty years of this one. tag the friend who's loved her since the curls-and-cowboy-boots days → longlivets.com/?item=vault-debut-taylor-swift-the-album-arrives&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=heartbeat
